review_id.description: The id of the review whose pages you classified, such as cr_01...

pages.description: One verdict per review page whose role is not REVIEWER_ADDED or WAITING_PAGE, each page once.

review_page_id.description: The review_page_id get_review names for the page.

verdict.description: What the page is, by the rules of the prompt.

reason.description: One sentence of at most 300 characters naming what on the page decides the verdict.
